slides.title: mobile health teams running in Amhara
What the UN office says
slides.body: OCHA says only 16 of the 57 mobile health and nutrition teams needed in Amhara are working. Ten of those 16 may stop by the end of October because of funding.

slides.title: Displaced residents report cuts
slides.body: Displaced residents told Addis Standard that several groups providing food, nutrition and health care have ended or are preparing to end work.

slides.title: Aid continues, with limits
slides.body: OCHA says partners still deliver aid in Tigray, Amhara and Afar despite insecurity. It says needs exceed resources. Single report, not independently verified.

slides.title: Keep health aid funded and open to all.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
